import importlib.util, os, signal, time, json
from pathlib import Path
import torch
root=Path('/home/ehrli/ngn-data/t80-20261006')
source=Path('/home/ehrli/wt/t80-20261006/experiments/2026-10-06-t80-net.py')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('t80_owned',source)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
out=root/'orientation-h512'; out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
m.configure_interop(out)
torch.set_num_threads(2); torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
for name in ('ngn','sprt'): (out/name).symlink_to(root/name)
for signum in (signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGINT,signal.SIGALRM): signal.signal(signum,m.interrupted)
signal.alarm(max(1,int(m.DEADLINE-time.time())))
original_disk=m.disk
def disk_checked(folder,stage):
    original_disk(root,'h512-'+stage)
    return original_disk(folder,stage)
m.disk=disk_checked
env=dict(os.environ,GOAMD64='v3',GOMAXPROCS='1',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOPROXY='off',OMP_NUM_THREADS='2',MKL_NUM_THREADS='2',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='2')
env['WSLENV']=env.get('WSLENV','')+':GOMAXPROCS/w'
assert json.loads((root/'gate-h512.json').read_text())['accepted']
assert m.sha(root/'h512/best.nnue')=='c6c127966d1cd9848b8bbe836ae74d5672874a3e74e973a488e4d92e350416f2'
m.write(out/'metadata.json',dict(source=str(source),source_sha256=m.sha(source),wrapper_sha256=m.sha(Path(__file__)),pid=os.getpid(),stop_command=f'kill -TERM {os.getpid()}',net_sha256=m.sha(root/'h512/best.nnue'),binary_digests=json.loads((root/'binary-digests.json').read_text()),deadline_utc='2026-10-07T10:55:00Z'))
m.write(root/'current-job.json',dict(stage='orientation-h512',pid=os.getpid(),stop_command=f'kill -TERM {os.getpid()}',child_status=str(out/'current-job.json')))
m.orientation(out,root/'h512/best.nnue',env)
m.write(out/'completed.json',dict(completed_utc=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),free_gib=m.disk(out,'completed'),orientation=json.loads((out/'orientation-results.json').read_text())))
m.write(out/'current-job.json',dict(stage='idle',pid=None))
m.write(root/'current-job.json',dict(stage='idle',pid=None))
print(json.dumps(json.loads((out/'orientation-results.json').read_text())),flush=True)
